title: Using Yelp, Facebook, and Google Review Logos | AssetLab Marketing

facts.fact: The page states that a Yelp badge is also available for businesses to display.
Per AssetLab's summary of Google's logo permissions, Google does not allow others to use the Google logo or Google My Business logo without specific written permission.
facts.quote: However, Google does not allow the logo to be used by others without specific written permission.

facts.fact: As of March 2018, no badge showing the count or rating of Google reviews was available to businesses.
facts.quote: as March 2018 there isn’t any way to get a badge that shows the count or rating associated with Google reviews.

facts.fact: Per AssetLab's summary of Facebook's brand guidelines, the Facebook "f" can be used in specific circumstances and ways, the image cannot be modified, and some uses are not allowed.
facts.quote: The Facebook “f” can be used in specific circumstances and in specific ways. The image itself cannot be modified and some uses are not allowed.

facts.fact: The page states that no Facebook badge is available; only the Facebook "f" version may be used.
facts.quote: Facebook – Yes, Just the “f” version, no badge available

facts.fact: Per the page, businesses are not allowed to use the Thumbtack logo.
facts.quote: Businesses are not allowed to use the Thumbtack logo

facts.fact: Per the page, businesses may show the Thumbtack Pro badge or Reviews Badge only if it is loaded live from Thumbtack with an HTML snippet.
facts.quote: they are allowed to show the Thumbtack Pro badge or the Reviews Badge as long as it is loaded live from Thumbtack with an HTML snippet.

facts.fact: The page states that Thumbtack Pro and Review badges are available.
facts.quote: Thumbtack – No, Pro and Review badges available
